text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tip-tap, tip-tap!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry up! This way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are about to start, but Copano
Rickey feels a strange shift
in the
atmosphere. She runs into the building,
and as she leaps up the
stairs...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Good! From here, I can...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because when you want to see the whole
picture, the best way is to
get a bird's-eye
view from above! This is geographical feng
shui in
action!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let me see if I can find what's causing this
qi disruption...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, over there! In that corner! A lot of
trainers are gathering in one
spot. But
why?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Is it because of the renovations on the
track? Oh, I know—the next
race has a lot
of front runners, so they probably want to
watch the
fight for position. The two just
so happened to coincide!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's not safe for them to run like
this! We have to stop the
race from
happening!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Can't we shout?! I don't know if
they'd believe us over the
phone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
At least the disruption doesn't look like
it'll get any bigger.
Hopefully, the five
elements can ward off misfortune long
enough to
see them through...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race begins...

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, run straight! Are you even looking?!
Out of my way!

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text: You're the one who needs to move! Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race ends without any disqualifications
or tumbles, but as Copano
Rickey
predicted, it was quite the rough race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm so glad nothing disastrous
happened. Thankfully, it wasn't
too bad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Instinct? Not at all! Feng shui isn't
something wishy-washy like that!
It's a
well-established discipline!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Remember when we looked down from the
roof? Well, that's when I
realized.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In the qian direction... that is to say, the
northwest, a group of
trainers had
gathered to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Their presence pulled the racers' attention
towards the qian direction,
and when
everyone's qi is in the realm of do-or-die
competition...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for racers to miss small
things, like being careless
while turning
the corner in front of them, or even
crashing into
another racer.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you have to always be on
the lookout for inauspicious
turns and the
borders of the eight trigrams.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I could see all of that through feng shui.
Not just me, but anyone
could've seen that
coming if they had the proper knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui isn't superstition. It's an ancient
practice that has been
honed over 3,000
years—a study of environmental luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought she was just the superstitious
type, but maybe I was wrong.
She did back
herself up, and her predictions even came
true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The feng shui-obsessed Copano Rickey
might be a lot more sensible
than I first
thought. Who knows? She could be hiding
limitless
potential.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See? Now you understand how amazing
feng shui is, right? It lets you
see into the
future! I bet you can't wait to tell everyone
about it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: What?! You're a tough nut to crack, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll give it one last push! I'm in
the next race, so watch me
run!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the power of feng shui in
action! ☆ After this, you won't
be able to
deny it anymore. It'll be the best proof
yet!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The qi of the earth is always with me.
When I get really into my
running, I can
even hear its voice! Here I go! Rickey! ☆
Lucky! ☆
Great victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm left pondering about the earth's voice
as she heads off to run in
the next
tryout—a mile race on turf.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It's started! Okay, no problems so far, and
the formation is as
expected. If I imagine
the eight trigrams lying over the track, it's
easy
to read my place.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: For the moment, I'll keep up this pace. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Here! Right before the last corner! This is
where it comes down to
reading. I've got
to pay attention to the qi around me...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to listen to the earth's
voice and run toward the flow
of qi...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Now, where will it lead me today?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, what? Huh?! What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't hear the earth's voice today! No,
this can't be happening!
Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey loses the race, failing to
show off the power of feng
shui that she
had so confidently declared.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm telling you, that's not how it
usually goes! Normally, the
earth's voice
guides me across the finish line in first!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Something was off today. The balance of
the elements? Or the
influence of the
wind? Maybe I was thrown off by the
trouble in the
last race.

Rickey, you were a mess out there... But I
guess it was inevitable.
Predictable, even.

You've got to stop going on and on about
feng shui. Wake up and
put that energy
into training!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tarumae... So you saw my race, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm Hokko Tarumae, a friend of
Rickey's. I come from
Tomakomai, where I
perform as a local idol.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey constantly pushes her feng shui
onto me, and frankly, I'm tired
of it. I hope
she comes to her senses soon and stops.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You mean you still don't believe me? Feng shui really is powerful! That said...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what went wrong today.
Oooooh, I just don't get it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey laments her defeat with
Hokko Tarumae. Is there
really any truth
to feng shui? And if there is, why didn't it
work for her
today?
